beastmastersHut.name: Beastmaster's Hut
beastmastersHut.description: (Reduces damage received by units in the visiting hero's army permanently)

rewards.message:
{Beastmaster's Hut}

An old beastmaster hands you a container with bugs:
"By eating these bugs, your solders will be better!" - he says with lots of enthusiasm. You hesitantly take the container.

(Units in the hero's army permanently receive 2% less damage from attacks)

beastmastersHut.onVisitedMessage:
{Beastmaster's Hut}

The old beastmaster is boasting "They are now better, huh?"
